author: Haichuan Wang

steps.title: Synthesize Magnetic Nanoparticles
steps.instruction: Prepare black magnetic nanoparticles by reacting iron salts with sodium hydroxide.

substeps.instruction: Mix FeCl2·4H2O and FeCl3·6H2O (molar ratio Fe(II):Fe(III) = 0.55:1) in 94 ml deionized water in a 500 ml glass flask.
Filter the solution using Whatman filter paper (Cat. 1440-005) to remove impurities.
Transfer to a 500 ml three-necked, round-bottomed flask with a magnetic stirrer and add 50 ml NaOH (5.0 M) to reach pH 14.
Heat at 60 °C for 30 minutes with vigorous stirring.
Immediately switch to slow stirring for 1 hour at 80 °C under a nitrogen atmosphere to produce Fe3O4 nanoparticles.

steps.title: Coat Nanoparticles with Sodium Alginate
steps.instruction: Coat the nanoparticles with SA powder and wash to reach neutrality.

substeps.instruction: Add 5g (0.08 mole) of SA powder to the nanoparticle suspension (~150 mL) at a molar ratio of 0.55 Fe(II): 1 Fe(III): 2 SA.
Separate the SA coated Fe3O4 by placing the flask on a regular magnet for 30 minutes at room temperature.
Pour off the aqueous solution.
Add 250 ml pure water, let sit on the magnet for 30 minutes at room temperature, and pour off the water.
Repeat the washing process (adding water and magnetic separation) five times.
Add 250 ml pure water and measure the pH using a Thermo Scientific Orion Star™ A215 Benchtop pH/Conductivity Meter.
If pH is not 7, repeat the washing process 2-3 more times until pH 7 is reached.
Store the final solution of SA coated magnetic particles in a sealed 100 ml glass bottle at room temperature.

steps.title: Prepare Leaf Tissue Samples
steps.instruction: Collect and lyophilize leaf discs from soybean, wheat, and maize.

substeps.instruction: Collect 1/4 inch leaf discs using a paper puncher (Amazon, A7074005S) from soybean (V2 stage), wheat (Feekes 2 stage), and maize (V3 stage).
Place 5, 10, or 15 leaf discs per collection per crop into 1.1 ml bullet tubes (three reps per crop).
Load tubes into a 2 ml Avan 96-well deep plate and add five 2 mm ceramic beads (Biospec. Cat. 11079124zx) to each tube.
Cover the plate with cheese cloth and secure with a rubber band.
Set Virtis Freezemobile Lyophilizer (25x) to -80 °C and 50 mT vacuum.
Once settings are reached, load the plate and lyophilize overnight at -80 °C and 50 mT.
Remove the plate, seal tubes with 1.2 ml micro titer tube caps, and store at room temperature.
Collect 1 dry soybean or 1-3 dry wheat seeds per 1.1 ml tube.
Add eight 2 mm ceramic beads (Biospec. Cat. 11079124zx) to each tube and seal.
Add 500 µl extraction buffer to each tube and store at 4 °C overnight before grinding.

steps.title: Extract Genomic DNA
steps.instruction: Grind tissues and extract DNA using SA coated magnetic nanoparticles.

substeps.instruction: Load leaf tissue tubes into a TissueLyserII (Qiagen) using the Adapter Set; shake for 30/s for 5 min, repeat once.
Remove tubes and spin down at 3700 rpm for 30 sec.
Add 500 µl DNA extraction buffer (Tris-HCl 50 mM pH 6.5, CTAB 1%, EDTA 10 mM, beta-mercaptoethanol 5%, 1.4 M NaCl, 2% PVP-40) and seal with 1.2 ml tube caps.
Incubate lyophilized leaf tissues at 65 °C for 60 min in a water bath; wipe water from the plate.
Centrifuge at 3700 rpm for 15 min at 25 °C.
For seed samples, follow the same grinding and centrifugation steps (steps 32-36 and 38-41).
In a new 0.2 ml 96-well non-skirt plate, add 2 µl beads (60 ng/µl) and 1 µl RNase A (1 µg/µl) to each well.
Transfer 100 µl supernatant from each tube into the corresponding well.
Mix by pipetting up and down 3 times and incubate on the bench for 10 min at room temperature.
Add 100 µl isopropanol, mix by pipetting 3 times, and incubate on the bench for 10 min at room temperature.
Place the plate on a dynaMag-96 magnet for 5 min.
Carefully pipette out all solution without disturbing the bead pellet on the wall.
Add 100 µl 80% EtOH without disturbing beads, then remove EtOH and air dry for 5 min.
Remove plate from magnet and add 50 µl 10 mM Tris-HCl (pH 8).
Mix via pipette or slight vortex and spin down the plate.
Leave the plate on the bench for 10 min at room temperature (off magnet).
Place plate back on the magnet for 3-5 min.
Transfer the DNA solution (~50 µl) to a new PCR plate.

steps.title: Quantify and Validate DNA
steps.instruction: Measure DNA concentration and verify quality via gel electrophoresis.

substeps.instruction: Measure DNA concentration using Qubit 2.0 (Qubit™ dsDNA Quantification Assay Kits, Q32850).
Load 1 µl DNA per sample onto a 1.5% agarose gel with SYBR, using Lambda DNA as a marker.
Run the gel at 120 V for 45 min in 1x TBE buffer.
Evaluate the gel under a UV Transilluminator (UVP) at 488 nm.
Label and seal the plate with foil (Thermo Scientific, Cat. 232698) and store at -20 °C.
Create a daughter plate with DNA diluted to 12 ng/µl and store at -20 °C.
In 200 µl PCR tubes (Axygen, Cat. PCR02C), mix 5 µl 2x master mix (BioRad, Cat. 172-5310), 0.25 µl of 10 µM forward and reverse primers, and 1 µl genomic DNA (final volume 10 µl).
Run PCR on BioRad C1000: 98 °C/30 s, then 21 cycles of (98 °C/10 s, 60 °C/30 s, 72 °C/30 s), and a final 72 °C/60 s, holding at 12 °C.
Load 3 µl DNA per sample onto a 1.5% agarose gel with SYBR and a 100 bp DNA ladder.
Run at 120 V for 45 min in 1x TBE buffer and evaluate under UV at 488 nm.

steps.title: MIP Hybridization and Extension
steps.instruction: Prepare and hybridize Molecular Inversion Probes (MIPs).

substeps.instruction: Dilute 998 individual probes (IDT) at 0.2 nmole with nuclease-free water at 1:10; mix and spin down.
Incubate PCR tubes at 37 °C for 30 min, then inactivate kinase at 75 °C for 10 min; spin down and keep on ice.
Prepare a hybridization/extension master mix containing 1.05 μl pooled phosphorylated probes.
In a new 384-well plate, add 5.25 μl of 12 ng/ul DNA sample (63 ng) per well.
Dispense the master mix using a Mantis Liquid Handler (Formulatrix) to a final volume of 12.5 µl per well.
Seal with film, vortex, and spin down.
Run thermal cycler program: 98 °C for 10 min, then 60 °C for ~24 h. Set heated lid to 105 °C for the first 30 min, then 80 °C for the remainder.
Spin down and leave plate on ice.
Remove sealing film.
Dispense 2 μl mix of 6.4 U Exo I (NEB), 32 U Exo III (NEB), and 0.2 μl 1× Ampligase DNA ligase buffer into each well using Mantis.
Seal, vortex, and spin down.
Incubate at 37 °C for 30 min, followed by 95 °C for 2 min.
Remove from thermal cycler, spin down, and leave on ice.

steps.title: MIP Amplification and Sequencing
steps.instruction: Amplify circularized MIPs and sequence via NextSeq.

substeps.instruction: Prepare PCR master mix: 2.5 μl 2× iProof HF Master Mix (BioRad) and 0.75 μl water per reaction; vortex and keep on ice.
In a new 384-well PCR plate, add 0.5 μl of 10 μM indexed forward and reverse primers per well.
Transfer 1.25 μl of circularized MIP capture as template using a multichannel pipette.
Dispense 3.75 μl master mix using Mantis, seal, vortex, and spin down.
Run PCR: 98 °C for 30 s; 21 cycles of (98 °C/10 s, 60 °C/30 s, 72 °C/30 s); and 72 °C/60 s, holding at 12 °C.
Spin down, remove seal, and pool 1 μl/well/sample into a 1.5 ml centrifuge tube; mix and keep on ice.
Run 30 μl of pooled PCR products on a 1.5% agarose gel with 50-bp and 100-bp ladders for 25-30 min at 120 V.
Stain gel with 1x SYBR for 5-10 min.
Excise the sharp band at ~286 bp using a razor blade.
Purify DNA using a Qiagen gel extraction kit.
Sequence on NextSeq 550/500 (Illumina) at 150 bp single read with specific primers.
Filter raw reads using Trimmomatic to remove adapter contamination, truncated reads, and low-quality bases.
Align filtered reads to a custom reference genome (200-bp flanking regions around 998 targeted SNPs) using Bowtie 2 in end-to-end mode with sensitive setting.
Discard reads with a mapping quality score of 20.
